channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: Scammers Are Trying To Extort Chicago Restaurants With ‘Bomb’ Of Fake Negative Reviews
item.description: Alpana, SHŌ and Beity are among the restaurants that recently faced a barrage of negative reviews. Google rolled out a new reporting measure to address the issue.

item.title: State And Lake CTA Station Closing For 3 Years Starting In January
item.description: Trains will not stop at the State and Lake station until 2029, when a new modern, glass-covered station will open to the public. The Red Line will still stop at Lake.

item.title: Joe Swanberg’s Video Store Finds New Home At The Davis Theater
item.description: Analog, Swanberg’s subscription-based pop-up, revives the browsing experience and curated selections of video rental’s heyday. It’s housed in the Davis’ cocktail lounge.

item.title: This Northwest Side Mom Wants To Help Families Get Outside And Explore Nature Year-Round
item.description: Megan Blomquist Sklenar founded City Kids Outdoors during the pandemic, organizing nature meetups for Chicago families. "I want more people out in our nature here in Chicago," she said.

item.title: 2 Weeks In Photos: Record Snowfall, South Shore Raid Fallout And Much More
item.description: PHOTOS: Take a peek at life in the city through the eyes and lenses of the Block Club Chicago staff.

item.title: 30 Holiday Pop-Ups And Bars In Chicago To Get You Feeling Festive
item.description: Celebrate with Santa, grab cookies with your drinks and dance the night away at these Christmas- and Hanukkah-themed pop-ups and bars.

item.title: Inmigrantes De Chicago Tienen Problemas De Salud Mental Tras Las Redadas De ICE: ‘Quieren Que Estemos Asustados’
item.description: Algunos profesionales de la salud mental brindan apoyo, talleres y guías gratuitos a las familias afectadas, que según algunos han sido de ayuda. Pero el trauma persiste.

item.title: Bronzeville Boy Hospitalized After School Playground Attack As Mother Fights To View Video Footage
item.description: Leslie McLaurin said she warned the school of bullying for months and is pushing for CPS to release video from the incident, which left her 6-year-old son with a concussion, keeping him out of school for weeks.

item.title: Reopened Property Tax Appeals Process Available For Another Week Following Massive Bill Spikes
item.description: Chicagoans have through Dec. 12 to appeal their latest assessment and potentially lower their property tax bill next year. South and West side homeowners were hit hardest by spiking bills this year, a recent report found.

item.title: South Shore Tenants Ask Judge For 60 More Days, $7,500 Each To Move Out From Building Raided By Feds
item.description: Residents of 7500 S. South Shore Drive have asked a county judge to extend her Dec. 12 deadline to clear the building, citing a "strained shelter system," long public housing waitlists and high rental costs.
